pattern: proxy finish LIGHT (proxy_finish.py stage_light + proxy_finish_light.py): the frozen Pixal3D sheet proxy kept as generated (geometry + texture), made watertight, decimated, baked, optionally reposed with bones

config.fit_side_length_why: UNIT NOTE + proxy gate (sha 8633d29a): side length / front height 0.671 vs the sheet's 0.596 (+12.6 %): Y scaled x 0.888 to the sheet

refloor.why: sheet_proxy floored the TAIL-train tip (x -2.37, y 0.46..0.84, z 0.000: the train swung to -x behind the body); the talons hung 0.090 u above it (front foot x 0.4..0.6, y -0.4..-0.2, z 0.090; rear foot x -1.2..-0.8, y 0.6..1.0, z 0.13). Floor to the lowest TALON contact (window y -1.7..0.3 = the front foot only), then x(6.89 / 6.762) = 1.019 to the sheet front height (sheet front 6.89 / side 6.82 u: -1.0 %, the views agree; back 7.02 is the 3/4 back with the crest arc higher)

dense.why: the head: pangolin helmet plates, elongated snout (tip y -2.08, z 5.37 stage frame; proxy landmark front_most y -2.30 z 5.357, sha 8633d29a, x0.888 x1.019), the crest arc (top z 6.89 at x -0.62) and both red eyes; turned to -x as generated (the sheet front is 3/4); vg_weight 0.1 so the two eye boxes below can sit denser
the -x red eye (proxy red texels a* > 30, L* > 25: x -1.26..-1.21, y -1.60..-1.55, z 5.93..6.00 stage frame, rgb 154,22,25): held dense so the painted eye keeps its own faces
the second red eye (x -0.97..-0.92, y -1.77..-1.71, z 5.90..6.00 stage frame, rgb 145,26,27): held dense, as above

floor_lift.why: after the refloor the tail-train tip (x < -1.4, y 0.4..0.9) hangs 0.092 u below the floor (the sheet draws the train ON the floor line); squashed up onto z 0 within the bottom 0.35 u; both feet (x >= -1.25) keep weight 0

light.ao_why: AO baked on the watertight low itself: the layered blade-scale soup has inner shells that black-hole AO rays (storm_bear / vulture_creature / azure_scale_mage lesson)
light.ao_distance_why: about one blade-scale length: real crevices darken, not the whole layered coat (batch lesson: AO darkens the basecolor below the sheet)
light.ao_fill_why: AO texels under 0.04 (bake origins inside the scale soup) refilled from valid neighbours
light.bake_drop_interior_why: proxy faces with solid on both sides (inner scale shells) left out of the bake source so the cage stays tight
light.uv_island_margin_why: the blade-scale low unwraps into thousands of islands; the default margin starves the atlas (storm_bear / vulture_creature idiom)

yaw.why: v2 (artist 2026-10-17: 'our characters should be symmetrical head turns are done through posing so our models remain flexible'): Pixal3D copied the sheet's 3/4 FRONT by building the whole assassin turned about Z. Measured on the v1 low (renders/shadowscale/_light/prerepose_low.npz, stage-1 frame): head z 5.4..6.95 best mirror plane yaw -41.5 deg through (0.32, 0) with p99 0.146 u (x = 0: 1.237); head slabs z 5.0..5.8 / 5.8..6.95 agree (-41.0 / -42.0); the two painted red eyes sit at lateral -0.139 / +0.229 about that plane, z 5.956 / 5.935 (dz 0.021), snout tip lateral +0.075: the face is TURNED, not sculpted crooked; the two feet lie on a line at -41 deg (side by side across the turned body). +41.5 deg about the origin puts the head plane at x +0.24 and the hip slabs at x 0.00..+0.08; to x -0.10 splits that lean (head +0.14, hips -0.06). One rigid turn (no vertex moves relative to another); the repose below works in this turned frame

rig.spine_why: v2, turned frame (light.yaw +41.5, to x -0.10): torso slab medians y -0.23 (z 2.2) .. -0.61 (z 4.6); neck = the v1 neck joint turned (0.04, -0.54, 4.9); the head bone runs along the face's own forward axis on the head plane x +0.14 (snout tip turned: x +0.22, y -2.51, z 5.32), so heading -y is ~0 deg and the head stays as generated

chains.name: arm
chains.why: v2, turned frame (arm columns of the v1 low in 0.3-0.4 u slabs): points = the +x blade arm hanging at the side (x med +1.01..+1.05, y -0.3..-0.5 from z 4.4 down to the claws z 1.6); points_R = the -x arm as generated, carried FORWARD across the chest (x -0.45..-0.59, y med -1.45 at z 4.6 to -2.17 at z 2.2, hand to y -2.6); the repose makes the pair mirror-symmetric (mean)

chains.name: leg
chains.why: v2, turned frame (leg-column tracking, 0.15 u slabs, radius 0.4, + floor clusters z < 0.08): points = the +x leg, planted and upright (column x +0.45..+0.53, y -0.1..+0.03 for z 0.2..1.7; talons x 0.3..1.1, y -1.1..+0.3 on z 0), points_R = the -x leg as generated, splayed OUT (column x -1.36 at z 0.5, -1.22 at z 1.2, -0.97 at z 2.3; foot x -1.9..-1.25 on z 0, with the coat-train fan to x -2.85 around it); the hips are set mirror-symmetric

chains.name: tail
chains.why: v2 (artist 2026-10-17: a tail chain that rests centred and can be posed to either side): a 3-bone TAIL CHAIN (tail.0..tail.2) through the blade-scale tail / coat train behind the hips (turned frame: slab medians x +0.21..+0.45, y 1.0 at z 2.0 .. 2.12 at z 0.0, tip y 2.67)

clips.why: PLACEHOLDER (movement + height are the open artist questions): idle = breathe + the kit's arm / tail sway; walk = a measured stalk (leg_swing 8: the kit's foot bend dips the toes below the floor at larger swings)

config._doc: LIGHT finish of the raw Pixal3D proxy (seed 56, sha 8633d29a). Points: stage-1 frame (fit_side_length Y x0.888, floor at the front talons, x1.019 to the sheet front height), sheet units.

targets.why: artist 2026-10-17: symmetric rest pose. The -x leg's outward splay (ankle x -1.46 vs the +x ankle +0.50) is pose: both legs carried onto the planted, upright +x leg (match L, as azure_scale_mage), both feet planted on z 0. Offline on the v1 low: leg stretch p99 2.32 (mean: 2.25 but a wide A-stance the sheet does not draw); falloff 0.12 was worse (3.26); plant_radius 0.8 (run 1 at 0.5 left coat-fan spikes around the -x foot 0.112 u below the floor, so the export centring floated both feet 0.11 u; offline at 0.8: lowest point -0.024 u, -x foot +0.029)

the arms mirror-symmetric at the mean (the -x arm hung ~1.5 u further forward across the chest); match L (both arms hanging) pulled the front cloth harder offline (arm stretch p99 5.57 vs 2.93); no plant, the claws hang free

targets.heading: -y
targets.why: the face straight ahead: after the +41.5 root turn the head plane is at yaw 0 (residual expected ~0); the head is RIGID (below)

targets.heading: +y
targets.why: the tail / coat train on the midline (heading +y = each tail bone yawed onto straight back); the chain rests centred and is posed to the side later

rigid.why: the whole head (pangolin helmet plates, snout, crest arc, both painted red eyes; z > 5.1 in the turned frame) moves as ONE rigid body with the head bone: never deformed or re-sculpted (face as generated)

repose.why: v2 (artist 2026-10-17, 'our characters should be symmetrical head turns are done through posing so our models remain flexible'): the proxy's root turn is undone as ONE rigid turn (light.yaw) and the splayed -x leg / forward -x arm / swung train with BONES (proxy_finish_repose) in the turned frame, never by mirror-averaging geometry. v1 colours, dense, AO, floor_lift are unchanged (stage-1 boxes)

config.focus_why: v2: focus boxes in the turned frame (light.yaw)

high.rule: marching tets of the whole remesh grid (no mirror)

low.method: collapse decimation: uniform to 300000, then 18000 with the dense boxes calibrated

dense.rule: dense boxes weighted 0.02 (vs 1) in the collapse decimation; the factor bisected until the boxes hold density x the rest's triangles per area

ao_fill.rule: AO < below = a bake origin inside the proxy soup: refilled from the covered valid 3x3 neighbours ring by ring (opt-in light.ao_fill_below)

bake.source: the proxy mesh itself (not the remesh)

mirror_after.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

yaw.why: v2 (artist 2026-10-17: 'our characters should be symmetrical head turns are done through posing so our models remain flexible'): Pixal3D copied the sheet's 3/4 FRONT by building the whole assassin turned about Z. Measured on the v1 low (renders/shadowscale/_light/prerepose_low.npz, stage-1 frame): head z 5.4..6.95 best mirror plane yaw -41.5 deg through (0.32, 0) with p99 0.146 u (x = 0: 1.237); head slabs z 5.0..5.8 / 5.8..6.95 agree (-41.0 / -42.0); the two painted red eyes sit at lateral -0.139 / +0.229 about that plane, z 5.956 / 5.935 (dz 0.021), snout tip lateral +0.075: the face is TURNED, not sculpted crooked; the two feet lie on a line at -41 deg (side by side across the turned body). +41.5 deg about the origin puts the head plane at x +0.24 and the hip slabs at x 0.00..+0.08; to x -0.10 splits that lean (head +0.14, hips -0.06). One rigid turn (no vertex moves relative to another); the repose below works in this turned frame
yaw.rule: p' = Rz(deg) (p - about) + to on every vertex of the finished low (one rigid turn about Z, the root orientation; no vertex moves relative to another)

stretch_all.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex
